name: GD AI
description: An experimental Geometry Dash learning agent: a Geode bridge and a PyTorch PPO brain.

enabled.name: AI enabled
enabled.description: While brain2.py is running, the AI takes control in levels.

speed.name: Game speed
speed.description: 1 = normal speed. Higher = faster learning (2 = twice as fast). The AI learns exactly the same at any speed. If your PC can't keep up, the game just runs as fast as it can and FPS drops.

normal-death.name: Normal death and restart
normal-death.description: The AI explodes and the level restarts like a normal attempt. Turn off for faster learning (instant restart).

allow-practice.name: Let the AI use practice mode
allow-practice.description: The AI's coach switches to practice mode by itself to train hard parts from a checkpoint. Turn off if it causes problems; the AI then only does full runs.

autoplay-level.name: Auto-open main level
autoplay-level.description: For recording: opens this main level (1 = Stereo Madness, 2 = Back on Track...) right after the game starts. 0 = off.

autoplay-replay.name: Auto-open plays the AI's replay
autoplay-replay.description: With 'Auto-open main level', play the AI's saved run of that level instead of letting it train. Handy for recording.

show-ai-vision.name: Show AI vision
show-ai-vision.description: Draws the grid the AI sees in front of the player (red = spike, green = block, yellow = orb/pad, blue = portal). The AI sees it either way.
